title: Encoding Phylogenetic Networks with Least Common Ancestor Constraints
summary: Encoding phylogenetic networks by suitable substructures is a central problem in phylogenetic combinatorics. We study encodings based on least common ancestor (LCA) constraints. For a directed acyclic graph (DAG) $G$ with leaf set $X$, we consider the relation on pairs of leaves in which $(ab,xy)$ records that the LCAs of $a,b$ and $x,y$ are well-defined and that the former is a descendant of the latter. We first identify precisely which part of $G$ is determined by this relation. To this end, we compare the canonical DAG constructed from the LCA relation with the 2-regularization of $G$,…
